title: Verify the 'Log In' button navigates to the next screen
preconditions: User is on the login screen
expected_result: The user is navigated to the next screen

title: Verify the email address field accepts valid input
preconditions: User is on the login screen
test_steps: Step 1: Enter 'appcrawler2@gmail.com' into the email address field | Step 2: Enter 'Crowd3456' into the password field | Step 3: Tap the 'Log In' button
expected_result: The user is navigated to the next screen

title: Verify the email address field accepts invalid input
preconditions: User is on the login screen
test_steps: Step 1: Enter 'invalidemail' into the email address field | Step 2: Enter 'Crowd3456' into the password field | Step 3: Tap the 'Log In' button
expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email is invalid

title: Verify the 'Forgot your password?' link is functional
preconditions: User is on the login screen
test_steps: Step 1: Tap the 'Forgot your password?' link
expected_result: The user is navigated to the password reset screen

title: Verify the app bar back arrow navigates to the previous screen
preconditions: User is on the login screen
test_steps: Step 1: Tap the back arrow in the app bar
expected_result: The user is navigated to the previous screen

title: Verify the text in the email and password fields has appropriate contrast
preconditions: User is on the login screen
test_steps: Step 1: Verify the text in the email field has a contrast ratio of ≥4.5:1 | Step 2: Verify the text in the password field has a contrast ratio of ≥4.5:1
expected_result: The text in both fields meets the WCAG AA contrast requirements

title: Verify the 'Log In' button has sufficient touch target size
preconditions: User is on the login screen
test_steps: Step 1: Verify the 'Log In' button has a touch target size of at least 44x44px
expected_result: The 'Log In' button has a touch target size of at least 44x44px
